Day 1 Convective Outlook
NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
0659 AM CST Wed Dec 25 2024

Valid 251300Z - 261200Z

...THERE IS A SLIGHT RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PORTIONS
OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS...

...SUMMARY...
Scattered severe thunderstorms capable of large hail and damaging
winds are possible across portions of the southern Plains this
afternoon and evening.

...Southern Plains...
A vigorous shortwave trough will move across the southern Rockies
today, driving a surface low and attendant cold front eastward
across the southern Plains. Ahead of the front, rich low-level
moisture will spread northward with surface dewpoints in the upper
50s to lower 60s. Moderate instability will develop by afternoon
with MLCAPE of 1000-1500 J/kg.

..Smith.. 12/25/2024
